title: Phase Switchboard: Gesture-Driven Rollout Composer (Prototype & Usability Review)
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design and prototype a compact, gesture-first rollout composer (the 'Phase Switchboard') that surfaces distribution, safety gates, cost/latency impact, and a one-tap rollback rehearsal. Target: engineers and SREs who run canary/A-B experiments and product managers who need quick briefings. The goal is a mobile-capable composer that reduces time-to-configure and increases confidence through a rehearsal sandbox and live cost/latency previews.
acceptance_criteria: Interactive prototype (Figma + clickable prototype) demonstrates: add variant, set % split via drag-swipe gesture, create isolation lane, and arm a safety gate.
Cost delta preview updates in real time when variant %s change (mocked data acceptable).
Rehearsal mode that runs a simulated traffic stream and highlights earliest failure signals; includes a visible ‘fast-return’ rollback trigger with confirmation UX.
Keyboard-accessible fallback controls for all primary interactions (add variant, adjust split, rollback).
Usability test with at least 6 participants (engineers/PMs) with task completion >= 80% for common flows.
Design spec doc with spacing/token guidelines, accessibility checks (contrast ratios, focus order), and developer handoff notes.
Checklist for telemetry hooks (event names, attributes) and guidance for linking to console dashboards.
Prototype includes a compact cost/latency overlay and a full expand view for power users.
decisions: Use a central ‘switchboard’ horizontal timeline as the primary surface rather than vertical stepper to improve glanceability on narrow screens.
Primary split adjustment interaction is drag-swipe on variant chips; a numeric input fallback is available in the expanded inspector.
Introduce an 'Isolation lane' (visual lane) to momentarily isolate cohorts for dark-launch style experiments instead of full traffic gating.
Rehearsal mode should be opt-in and simulate signals for latency, error rate, and cost; it will not run against live production traffic.
Cost preview will show delta-per-hour and delta-per-1000-requests with a predictable mock model for the prototype.
Keyboard shortcuts: 'A' add variant, 'R' arm rehearsal, 'U' quick-undo rollback (with modal confirmation).

review_feedback: Alexei Novak (Eng): 'Love the rehearsal animation — add an explicit mapping to the real telemetry events we fire (latency_p50/p95, error_rate) so SREs can correlate.'
Priya Menon (PM): 'Isolation lane is promising but needs a clearer mental model — propose renaming to 'Shield lane' and surfacing typical use-cases in the inspector.'
Lars Becker (Accessibility): 'Ensure drag handle size meets touch target requirements; focus outline and aria labels needed for variant chips.'
Sophie Nguyen (Design Lead): 'Consider adding a cost/latency small-multiples visualization when expanded; avoid cramming too much into the collapsed composer.'
usability_plan: Recruit 6 participants: 3 engineers (platform/infra), 2 product managers, 1 SRE.
Tasks: (1) create an A/B split, (2) set up an isolation for 5% traffic, (3) run rehearsal and perform a quick rollback.
Metrics: task completion, time on task, error/confusion notes, subjective confidence score (1-7), suggestions log.
Schedule: 6 remote moderated sessions between 2026-03-12 and 2026-03-18.
Success criteria: mean confidence >= 5 and task completion >= 80% for primary flows.
implementation_notes: Provide a reusable 'variant-chip' component with drag-handle, percent badge, and compact keyboard controls.
Expose telemetry hooks: rollout.compose.start, rollout.compose.adjust, rollout.rehearsal.start, rollout.rollback.trigger (include variant ids, percents, user_id).
Mock cost model provided in prototype; backend to replace with cost_estimate API (schema to be defined by Eng team).
Rehearsal simulation to run in a sandbox environment; ensure non-destructive by design and require explicit opt-in toggle.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Users may misinterpret rehearsal as live traffic. Mitigation: prominent banner in rehearsal mode and color-coded sandbox accent.
Risk: Mobile drag interactions could be imprecise. Mitigation: snap-to-percent increments and alternative numeric input in inspector.
Risk: Cost preview accuracy could be mistaken for billing. Mitigation: show 'estimate' badge and link to billing docs.
next_steps: Iterate prototype based on usability sessions and re-run 3 follow-up tests for the updated microcopy (target completion 2026-03-18).
Finalize developer handoff sheet and issue a runtime ticket to implement telemetry and cost_estimate API (link below).
Align on naming: decision between 'Isolation lane' vs 'Shield lane' after PM vote (scheduled 2026-03-12 sync).
Add short tooltip onboarding flows for first-run users in the console.
blockers: Backend API for cost_estimate not yet available — ENG-94121 dependency.
Design review backlog: accessibility audit scheduled in Cycle 2026-W10 that must complete before final signoff.
